1. WHAT 文理生生 VERIFIES, AND HOW

1.1 Automatic checks (reproduced). [WVR] records release 0.4 with five validation groups, all passed. I reran each in its read-only --check mode. Each exited 0 and printed the saved figures:
- corpus/report_corpus.py: 55 units, 46 agreements, joint E 30, 302 integrity checks;
- constructions/validate_constructions.py: 194/194, of which 139 are structure checks and 55 finite-table calculations;
- constructions/independent_model_review.py: 36/36 over 12 cards;
- engine/verify_rules.py: 13 rules; 48 queries cross-checked against a second evaluator; 432 raw-fact checks; 2 type rejections; graph join 13 edges;
- basis/normalizer.py: 25 models, 2,750 formula inputs, 13,750 state-truth comparisons, 1,900 program-relation comparisons, 51 boundary checks.
A SHA-256 over every file in the data folder was identical before and after (9d2ad5ae…), so the checks wrote nothing. I also replicated the manifest check: 91 files, set and hashes equal to manifest.json. I did not run validate_release.py itself, because it spawns its subprocesses inside the data folder without -I.
What these checks establish is stated by the project itself in [WVR] "scope": consistency of frozen data, finite-model calculations and the implementation, and explicitly not prevalence, historical unity or minimality. [WINT] is a graph-integrity record for the website: 4,143 objects, 2,806 relations, no dangling references, and 24 frozen documents with no explicit relation. It checks references, not meaning.

1.2 The corpus pilot: two AI annotators. [WPILOT] (protocol v0.4-pilot-1, frozen 2026-10-21T13:43:50Z) fixes 55 contiguous units:
- 《老子》王弼本 chapters 1–8, scripture only (8 units);
- 《学而》 complete (16);
- 《说卦》 complete (11);
- the first 20 entries of 《墨经·经上》 (20).
Labels: E = an explicit relational schema (two roles, two stages, or condition and result, with a stated link); C = a contextual candidate; N = non-relational or unresolved. Annotator A ("root-A", locked 13:48:03Z, four minutes after the freeze) and annotator B (an agent whose statement says it read only the protocol and corpus) gave:
- A: E36 / C7 / N12; B: E31 / C9 / N15;
- exact agreement 46/55 (83.6%), joint E 30, joint C 4, joint N 12, nine disagreements, kept unrevised.
By text, joint E is 学而 15/16, 老子 6/8, 说卦 5/11 and 墨经 4/20.
The pilot reports no chance-corrected statistic, so I computed one from the two annotation files. Cohen's κ over E/C/N is 0.70 overall and 0.735 for E against not-E. By text: 老子 0.60, 学而 0.00, 说卦 0.70, 墨经 0.60. For 学而 the 15/16 agreement carries no information beyond the base rate: chance agreement is also 0.9375, because nearly everything was E.
The project names its own limits [WPILOT §判定方法; protocol.json "independence", "sampling_limit"]:
- shared research background, no blinding, not a human study;
- purposive, non-representative choice of texts;
- unequal unit lengths;
- the measure is the presence of at least one schema per unit, not coverage.
An independent AI short review [independent_review.md] confirmed the counts and asked for two clarifications, both applied (282→302 checks). It notes that the data files alone cannot prove the annotators were isolated.

1.3 Text evidence. [W06 §3] says all 69 evidence IDs were re-read against linked electronic transcriptions, at the level of quotations, chapters and context. It explicitly does not claim collation against bamboo or silk manuscripts, printed editions or critical editions. Eleven errors were corrected (R01–R11, [W06 §2]), among them a misplaced context for 气绝而不续 and an overgeneralized Five Phases mechanism.

1.4 Formal results. [WMIN §1–§5] gives two results.
- G1's 22 constructions reduce to 13 in G0. G0 is first-order dynamic logic over finite state sets with sorted domains: ⊤, atoms, =, ¬, ∧, ∃, ⟨π⟩ / a, ?, ;, ∪, sync (intersection), *. The reduction is proved by a prose mutual structural induction and cross-checked by the normalizer on 25 models.
- A lower bound: no fixed star-free forward formula decides reachability on all finite chains. This is a locality argument, the classical fact that unbounded reachability is not definable without a closure operator.
The proof review [basis/lower_bound_review.md] is by another AI agent. [WBOUND] says all the reviews are "另一AI代理的复核，不是外部人类同行评审". The construction reviewer also states that it had earlier drafted four of the twelve cards it reviewed [constructions/independent_model_review.md §方法与独立性].

2. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY NOT ESTABLISHED (the project's own words and figures)

- The original question is not settled. [W18 结论] says it is "尚未完全解决".
- Coverage of the classical lexicon:
  - 113/113 is only the enumeration of a chosen list, not coverage [W18 §2.2];
  - [W18J] coverage_denominator: population size null, large_part_fraction_estimable false;
  - the 211 senses, 32 compound rows, 67 labels and 7 case groups are different units and cannot be combined [W18 §2.1].
- No sense interface is wired to the engine: [W18J] has direct_engine_binding_true = 0 of 245. Nine interfaces have no source ID, being project definitions: 互, 层 ×2, 坏, 未, 而, 以, 改 ×2.
- Explanatory or learning gain (H2) is untested [W18 §4 and §8].
- The source of inferences is the model, not the characters. In the two-unit model the doubling follows from the update law, not from the words 感应 or 合势 [W18 §4].
- Unity across traditions is not shown [W18 §6]. There is also no cross-language comparison: [W18 §6] reads "当前没有语言间比较结果".
- Minimality is not shown:
  - the five elements 辨系序化限 have not been proved irreplaceable atoms [W18 §7.1];
  - the five carry modern design choices [W03 §一];
  - G0's 13 constructions are "not 13 irreducible primitives" [WMIN opening].
- The 八卦 mapping of the 113 characters is mostly bridging: 11 direct textual links, 32 Yi-system structural links, 30 modern bridges and 40 with no exclusive binding [W18 §2.1; W18J bagua12].
- The remaining goals are tabulated as unmet in [WBOUND §仍不能宣布完成的原始目标] and [WREADME 阶段结论].

3. HOW ITS STANDARDS COMPARE WITH THE THEORY'S

3.1 Proof.
- The theory requires every theorem to be checked in Lean with an empty axiom report: no propext, Quot.sound or Classical.choice [TOB Preface; §0 block A "Proof language"].
- The newest core receipt [RCPT] reads: status passed, Lean v4.29.1, 301 modules (285 core, 7 instance, 6 application, 3 foundation), 18,032 audited declarations, 13,142 of them theorems. Counting from its axiom_dependencies fields, 0 declarations have a nonempty axiom report.
- [CHK] (around lines 3443–3450) asserts empty reports for the spine and pure modules.
- AGENTS.md states that hand arguments and finite numerics do not replace Lean.
- 文理生生's formal results are hand proofs plus Python finite checks plus AI review. Under our rule they are candidate arguments, not results, until formalized. Both are known mathematics: derived operators of first-order dynamic logic, and the locality of star-free logic. They would go under the theory's "relation to known results", not on the spine as new laws.

3.2 Records and scope statements.
- Both projects separate standing carefully.
  - 文理生生 has three layers [W06 §6]: what the text says, what a modern construction can do, and what is empirically so.
  - The theory has four standings [TOB Preface] and, for sources, 相合 / 定域 / 相分 with "相合不是印证" [CIV §七].
- 文理生生's reproducibility apparatus matches ours in kind: hash-frozen inputs, saved results recomputed by --check, explicit scope fields.
- What it lacks is binding of its vocabulary to proved content: none of its 245 interfaces is engine-bound. In our 中华本, 376 of 447 names are anchored to current Lean declarations [CIV §五·二 rule 3].

3.3 Text checks.
- [VZH] checks the 438 imported files against PROVENANCE hashes, coverage of all 5,673 judgments, every fragment character by character in its frozen text, every declaration against the newest receipt, record links, and the generated tables.
- The ZH landing commit b2c1fae39 reports a pass: 1,228 quotations, 5,120 declarations, 682 record links, 135 对照 lines. The current work/verify-failures.txt is empty, and neither chapter has uncommitted changes.
- I did not rerun [VZH], because it writes work/verify-failures.txt and this task was read-only.
- Both projects work from electronic transcriptions without collation against printed editions [CIV §九; W06 §3]. At the text level they stand equal.

3.4 Annotation.
- Ours is broader but has no agreement statistic. [CIV §二] describes three AI reads per entry (mapper, reviser, checker). Of the 88 entries the reviser left unchanged, a second checker corrected 84. [CIV §九] notes that no human has read everything.
- 文理生生 has a frozen two-annotator agreement figure, but on 55 units in four texts.
- Each fills a gap in the other. Our mapping would gain a κ on a frozen sample. Their pilot would gain the third read our data showed is needed.

4. SUBSTANCE: THE TWO VOCABULARIES AND WHERE THEY CONVERGE

4.1 Lexicon overlap. I compared the 144 characters of the 文理生生 lexicon with our 447 names [NAMES] and our 37 declined symbols [NA], after simplifying.
- Of the 113 core characters, 52 are also single-character names in ours, 30 occur only inside our compound names, and 31 occur in none: 文 道 德 气 质 实 克 本 末 用 层 兴 盛 反 养 守 坏 熄 死 治 乱 觉 信 仁 礼 善 性 阴 阳 虚 弱.
- 17 of their 144 characters are ones our naming explicitly declined, with recorded reasons: 道 易 德 有 无 气 反 中 和 信 仁 义 礼 性 虚 天 人. Our naming also declined the compounds 阴阳 and 五行.
- Of their five hub characters (文理道易德, the 总纲 group in [W03 §一] and the [W18 附录A] list), our independent pass adopted only 理. It declined 道, 易 and 德, and has no name containing 文.
- [NA] gives the reasons: polysemy, and the four non-relational layers (a prior ground, a fixed nature or value, a will or single centre, a contest or rank) of [CIV §四·三].
- 文理生生 does not treat these characters as ontological primitives either. It types 仁义礼善 as normative interfaces and records forbidden coercions. The two projects therefore do different jobs: a descriptive lexicon of classical usage, versus names for checked concepts.

4.2 Ontology of the formal core.
- In [W07 §二], 辨 declares object sorts, identities, predicate signatures and equality, over a given state set S. That is an entities-and-predicates (Kripke and first-order) structure. [W03 §三] adds that 辨 is a modelling step needing no observer, and that the five work in parallel.
- Our core starts from one kind of relatum and the run as the only base. A configuration is how it relates (`Alike.tests`), and a World is a run (`World.run_world`) [TOB §0 block A, §1.1].
- Under [ND] and AGENTS.md (no formal variable may smuggle in an independent ontology), 文理生生's core would need a relation-first reconstruction before it could serve as ours.

4.3 Independent convergences. On shared passages the two AI-built projects reach matching verdicts:
- 穷则变通久 is conditional, not a law: [W18 §3] and the 09 case; [TOB §1.5] "窮則變 is not a law".
- 有无相生 is not unconditional mutual causation: [W18 §3] row; [NA] 有／无 (定域).
- 和而不同 is not homogeneity: [W18 §3]; our name 和而不同.
- 生生 on a finite domain: a fixed finite carrier cannot hold endlessly many new identities (independent_model_review.md §生生 3). Ours: endless novelty needs an open world, `more_needs_open` and `Accretion` [TOB §1.2, §1.5].
- Identity across change is not fixed by the dynamics alone: their identity I versus lineage L [W06 R01]; our identity across steps as a representation commitment [TOB §0 block A].
- 说卦's image tables are not dynamics: Y07–Y09 are joint N in [WPILOT]; [CIV §四·一] puts 易 divergence at 20%.
This is real mutual support for the method and for these verdicts. It is not statistical independence: both projects are AI-produced, with shared priors.

4.4 One tension worth noting. [CIV §五·一] cites the 墨经 "X，Y也" form as itself relational, using 法 and 體. In the pilot's first 20 墨经 entries, only 4 are joint E and 9 are joint N: 知，材也; 慮，求也; 義，利也; 禮，敬也; and others. The protocol excludes bare definitions by design, but the result still shows that the form is not uniformly relational. Our choice of examples did the work.

5. BEARING ON THE QUESTION WHETHER THIS IS THE BEST LANGUAGE FOR THE THEORY'S CORE

- The materials establish less than the question asks, and say so themselves.
  - There is no cross-language comparison [W18 §6].
  - The plan deferred any comparison with Western traditions [W01 §一, item 5].
  - The archived founding conversation already cautioned that Chinese holds no monopoly on systems thinking [W02, the passage on Greek, Sanskrit and English].
  - The pilot has no non-Chinese baseline. Its E criterion (two roles, or condition and result, with a link) would be met by much English prose, so 30/55 cannot show that Chinese is more relational than English.
- In both projects the core's language is a formal one. For 文理生生 it is first-order dynamic logic, and by its own audit the inferences come from the declared models [W18 §4]. For the theory it is Lean.
- In both projects the classical characters are a second layer. Its fitness is measured by fidelity: anchors, quotations and stated scope. Our 中华本 already realizes that layer over Lean, with 376 of 447 names anchored and 240 of 246 quoted names witnessed in pre-Qin texts [ZH 序; CIV §五·三].
- Two independently built classical vocabularies for becoming share only about half their core characters (52 of 113 coincide as single names). They disagree on the hub characters, 道德易文. So the texts do not determine one classical language for the theory. The choice is a convention constrained by historical sense, as both projects state: [W18 §5] calls the edge selection a research choice, and [CIV §五·一] calls the name table a convention (`SharedCodes`).
- What 文理生生 can add is concrete:
  - its 211 typed senses with forbidden coercions;
  - 12 construction cards, each with failure conditions;
  - the 9 annotator disagreements, as test cases for our 相合/定域 criteria;
  - a frozen-sample agreement method for our own mapping.
  Any new law drawn from it still needs Lean before it counts.

findings.point: All five 文理生生 check groups reproduce exactly. What they certify is the consistency of frozen data and of calculations on finite models, not the truth of readings or claims about the lexicon.
findings.evidence: I reran each script with python3 -I -B and --check. All exited 0: corpus 302 checks (55 units, 46 agreements, joint E 30); constructions 194/194; independent review 36/36; engine 13 rules, 48 cross-checked queries, 432 fact checks; normalizer 25 models, 2,750 formula inputs, 13,750 state comparisons. A hash over the whole data folder was identical before and after; the manifest's 91 files match. Its own scope field reads: 'not a proof of lexicon-wide prevalence, historical unity or universal minimality' [WVR scope].
findings.bearing: The checks show the project is internally sound and reproducible. They say nothing about whether its vocabulary fits the core better than another, and the project does not claim they do.

findings.point: The corpus pilot rests on two AI annotators who were not blinded and shared research context. They agree on 46 of 55 units; chance-corrected agreement, which the pilot does not report, is moderate overall and uninformative for 学而.

A ('root-A') locked its labels 4 minutes after the protocol freeze. The independent AI review notes that isolation of the annotators cannot be shown from the files alone [independent_review.md].

findings.point: The formal core of 文理生生 is first-order dynamic logic (PDL with sorted quantifiers and intersection). Its two formal results are prose proofs checked on finite models, and both are known mathematics.
findings.evidence: [WMIN §1–§5]: G1's 22 constructions reduce to 13 in G0 by a mutual structural induction, cross-checked on 25 models. The lower bound is a locality argument that star-free formulas cannot decide reachability. Both reviews are by AI agents [WBOUND; basis/lower_bound_review.md]. findings.point: The 文理生生 model declares object sorts, identities and predicates first (辨), over a given set of states. The theory's core starts from one kind of relatum and takes the run as its base.

findings.point: On passages both projects read, the two reach the same verdicts independently.
findings.evidence: Five shared verdicts: 穷变通久 is conditional ([W18 §3]; [TOB §1.5] '窮則變 is not a law'); 有无相生 is not unconditional mutual causation ([W18 §3]; [NA] 定域); 和而不同 is not homogeneity; a finite carrier cannot hold endlessly many new identities ([independent_model_review.md] 生生 §3; [TOB §1.2] Accretion, more_needs_open); identity across change is not fixed by the dynamics ([W06 R01]; [TOB §0 A] Identity). 说卦's image tables are joint N in [WPILOT], and [CIV §四·一] gives 易 20% divergence.
findings.bearing: This is genuine mutual support for the shared method and for these specific readings, which is the 'same principle verified independently' Ren hoped for. Both projects are AI-built with shared priors, so it is convergence, not statistical independence. It supports the classical layer as a faithful annotation, not as the best language for the core.

findings.point: The pilot puts pressure on our claim that the 墨经 'X，Y也' definitional form is itself relational.
findings.evidence: In the first 20 墨经 entries only 4 are joint E and 9 are joint N (知，材也; 慮，求也; 義，利也; 禮，敬也; and others) [WPILOT 全部单元]. findings.bearing: The relational character lies in the examples we chose, not in the form. This is a case of the general finding that 'naturally relational' holds as a leading thread and not as a property of the language: 81% agreement or scope, 19% divergence [CIV §四·四].

findings.point: At the text level the two projects stand equal; on binding names to proof and on breadth, ours is stronger. On agreement statistics theirs is stronger.

findings.bearing: Neither project shows the classical vocabulary is the best core language. Each has a method the other should adopt: a frozen-sample agreement statistic for our mapping, and a third read plus Lean anchors for theirs.

findings.point: What is explicitly not established, in the project's own records: coverage of the classical lexicon, gains in understanding or transfer (H2), unity across traditions, and minimality of the five elements or of G0.
findings.evidence: [W18 结论 and §1 table]; [W18 §7.1]: the five elements are not proved irreplaceable; [W03 §一]: the five carry modern design choices; [WMIN opening]: '13' is not 13 irreducible primitives; [W18 §8]: H2 untested; [W18J] bagua12: 11 direct, 32 Yi-system, 30 modern bridge, 40 no binding; [WBOUND] table of unmet goals; [WREADME 阶段结论].
findings.bearing: By its own standard, 文理生生 does not claim to be the minimal or best grammar for any system, including our core. The strongest claim it supports is that selected classical concepts can be reconstructed as a typed compositional vocabulary in specified finite models.

findings.point: There are assets that can be integrated under the theory's rules.
findings.evidence: 211 typed core senses with forbidden coercions (08 lexicon via [W18J]); 12 construction cards with original text, modern supplement, model and failure conditions [WREADME 复合表达]; 9 annotator disagreements with reasons [pilot_results.json]; the instance/pattern/lineage distinctions [W06 R01–R02]; finite-model counterexamples [WBOUND 修正].
findings.bearing: Integration should treat these as readings, test cases and candidates. A law drawn from them needs a board claim and a Lean proof before it counts. They enrich the classical annotation layer; they do not replace the core's language.
